provider.name: Sharper Trades
provider.tagline: An ecosystem of trading alerts, investment research and structured video courses, spanning options, swing trading, long-term stock picking and institutional order-flow analysis.
provider.about: Sharper Trades is run by Luca Moschini (founder, has trained over 180,000 students) and Kal Zurn (who leads the options services division). Rather than one single course, it's a suite of separate products covering different trading styles — real-time alerts, video courses and a monthly stock-picking service — which can be bought individually or bundled together.

courses.name: Essential Option Income System
courses.tagline: Real-time alerts for busy people who just want plug-and-play options trades.
courses.about: An alert-only service (no video course) aimed at traders who want clear, research-backed options trades without doing their own market analysis — built for beginners and people with limited time.

formats.label: Real-time trade alerts
formats.description: 2–3 alerts per week with entry/exit specifics, trade reasoning and a closing alert when the trade is done.

formats.label: Risk management guidance
formats.description: Built into every alert, rather than a separate module.

pricing.name: Annual
pricing.billing_note: Equivalent to 10 months — 2 months free versus paying monthly.

testimonials.quote: I was honestly scared to place my first options trade. The alerts took that fear away.
testimonials.author: Ellen A.

testimonials.quote: What surprised me most is how calm trading feels now. I'm not panicking.
testimonials.author: Luther L.

testimonials.quote: This feels thoughtful and professional, compared to other services.
testimonials.author: Hank G.

courses.name: Block Orders
courses.tagline: Trade around institutional levels, not guesswork.
courses.about: A real-time alert service that flags unusual institutional trading activity, aiming to show both the trade direction and the reasoning behind it rather than just a signal to follow.

formats.label: Real-time trade alerts
formats.description: Long and short setups built around institutional-level activity, with defined support/resistance levels and targets.

formats.label: Ongoing market insights
formats.description: Ongoing context and commentary alongside the alerts.

pricing.name: Annual
pricing.billing_note: Includes 2 months free. 7-day refund window on the annual plan.

courses.name: Stock Investor
courses.tagline: Build a portfolio of high-conviction ideas.
courses.about: A monthly stock-picking service for long-term investors, aiming to flag growth companies early. Each pick comes with an investment thesis, a 3–5 year price target, and supporting research.

formats.label: Monthly stock picks
formats.description: A curated portfolio of growth stocks with investment theses and price targets.

formats.label: Research reports
formats.description: Business breakdowns, risk analysis and supporting charts for each pick.

formats.label: Portfolio tracking
formats.description: Access to all current and past picks, with performance tracked over time.

courses.name: Pro Option Trader Academy
courses.tagline: Complete options mastery, plus real-time alerts.
courses.about: Combines the same alert service as the Essential Option Income System with a full video curriculum, aimed at traders who want to learn options trading properly rather than just follow alerts.

formats.label: Real-time trade alerts
formats.description: 2–3 alerts per week with closing alerts, same as the Essential Option Income System.

formats.label: Video course library
formats.description: A 12-course library from beginner to advanced, plus a 6-hour crash course, structured across 4 levels.

formats.label: Live webinars
formats.description: Ongoing live sessions for continuing education.

pricing.name: Annual
pricing.billing_note: Equivalent to 2 months free. 14-day refund window.

testimonials.quote: The alerts are great, but the education is what really made everything click.
testimonials.author: Sanjay G.

testimonials.quote: After going through the courses, that fear is mostly gone.
testimonials.author: Joy H.

testimonials.quote: I always know what to learn next, and everything builds on itself.
testimonials.author: Chandra S.

courses.name: Market Edge
courses.tagline: Trade short-term. Invest long-term. Build real market skill.
courses.about: A bundle combining three of Sharper Trades' other products into one system, for traders who want both active trading alerts and a long-term investing approach rather than buying each piece separately.

formats.label: Block Orders alerts
formats.description: Real-time trade setups built around institutional-level activity.

formats.label: Stock Investor picks
formats.description: Long-term portfolio opportunities with research and price targets.

formats.label: Swing Trading Masterclass
formats.description: The full 6-week video curriculum and execution training.

pricing.name: Annual
pricing.billing_note: Equivalent to 2 months free. Each component is also sold separately.

courses.name: Swing Trading Masterclass
courses.tagline: A complete 6-week system to learn the market, identify high-quality setups, and execute with confidence.
courses.about: A structured 6-week video course on swing trading, built for traders who already know the basics but want a repeatable system rather than guesswork. The provider is explicit that it isn't aimed at get-rich-quick seekers or day scalpers.

instructors.name: Luca Moschini
instructors.role: Founder, Sharper Trades — has trained over 180,000 students

curriculum.title: 6-Week Curriculum
topics: Technical indicators: moving averages, volume, balance of power, money stream
TC2000 platform training and simulator practice
Trading psychology and 10 rules for successful traders
Trading plan construction: position sizing and stop-loss strategy
Live trading examples across different market conditions
Stock scanner setup, unusual options and dark pool analysis

formats.label: Video lessons
formats.description: 6-week structured curriculum, released module by module.

pricing.name: Payment plan
pricing.billing_note: Totals $1,735 — more than the one-time price, spread over 5 months.
